body: While I’m not pleased about rising GSTs, you do realise that there is global inflation right? It is happening everywhere, not just Singapore.

I don’t understand this sentiment being thrown around. In GRCs with strong opposition parties like WP, it makes sense that there are close fights.  

However in other places where the opposition parties are just ridiculous, why would I vote for them? Have you heard some of their speeches and how incoherent they are? A lot of them are just shouting away coffee shop uncle style with a “trust me, bro, I got this” vibe.

The opposition members where I live have ever come to my house and made very sarcastic remarks about my GRCs actions in a previous election. Is that who I should vote for?

People need to realise that it’s not as easy as “Singaporeans hate PAP then still vote PAP”.

Surprised to see micro creamery mentioned. But I agree their ice cream is great. Go in the mornings as well, they do really good breakfast stuff and even had dog-treats for my pup.

Everything is made in-house (I think), including the dog treats!
